title: hep-simlib: checked response libraries and component interaction banks for HEP fast simulation
description: hep-simlib provides checked response libraries for fast simulation (manifests, content hashes, domain accounting, a fidelity vocabulary) and component interaction banks: complete Geant4 trials of a detector component recorded once and replayed exactly in any rigid placement, in Python (float64 and float32) and inside Geant4 through a fast-simulation model. It includes an experiment-neutral Geant4 recorder and validation campaigns on a public toy module.
